Exact_Claim: In simulations, accuracy collapses with noise dimensions and subsample stability collapses alongside it, so evidence for stability--accuracy discordance rests on the real cohorts.
Statistical_Method: Mean ARI and subsample stability across D_noise in [0, 5000]
Limitations: Isotropic Gaussian noise lacks covariance structure.
Safe_Manuscript_Wording: In isotropic simulations, accuracy and subsample stability collapse together as distractor dimensions expand, demonstrating that synthetic isotropic noise alone does not produce discordance.

Exact_Claim: Three of twelve methods (FCAG, FCM, FastMVC) show non-degenerate discordance on three cohorts each (mean stability 0.684, mean accuracy -0.003, permuted null ~ 0.01).
Statistical_Method: Pairwise ARI on overlapping instances across subsamples; permuted null controls; Rule (i') non-degeneracy filter.
Limitations: Rule (i') was formulated post-hoc after observing Core-Halo failure on Prostate.
Safe_Manuscript_Wording: Three of twelve methods (FCAG, FCM, FastMVC) show non-degenerate discordance on three cohorts each, averaging 0.684 stability and -0.003 accuracy against permuted nulls of ~0.01.

BGSS raises ARI to 0.217 under bipartite consensus (+0.169 over matched random gating, 95% CI [+0.036, +0.310], Wilcoxon p = 0.031 uncorrected, n = 6), driven by Leukemia and SRBCT, but only to 0.077 under dense consensus (+0.031).
Seed_Count: 30 canonical random seeds per cell across 6 cohorts
Statistical_Method: 2x2 factorial ANOVA and paired Wilcoxon signed-rank tests.

Safe_Manuscript_Wording: BGSS raises mean ARI to 0.217 under bipartite consensus (+0.169 over matched random gating, uncorrected Wilcoxon p = 0.031, n = 6), driven by Leukemia and SRBCT, but only to 0.077 under dense consensus.

Exact_Claim: Bipartite compression reduces consensus-graph memory by 99.6% at N = 10^4.
Statistical_Method: Direct array byte measurement and tracemalloc peak process heap tracking.
Limitations: Applies to auxiliary consensus graph array memory; total process memory reduction is 97.4%.
Safe_Manuscript_Wording: Bipartite graph compression reduces auxiliary consensus-graph storage by 99.6% at N = 10^4 (3.05 MB vs. 762.9 MB), with a 97.4% reduction in total process heap memory (68.8 MB vs. 2,670.6 MB).

Exact_Claim: Proposition 1: Conditional Multimodality Separation Bound (E[b_d] ~ 1/3 for normal, 5/9 for uniform, Delta/sigma_0 > 1.854 for b_d > 5/9 in Gaussian mixtures).
Statistical_Method: Pearson kurtosis moment derivation for continuous symmetric mixtures.
Limitations: Holds strictly for symmetric unimodal distributions; fails on skewed unimodal distributions.
Safe_Manuscript_Wording: Proposition 1 (Conditional Multimodality Separation Bound for Symmetric Densities): For symmetric unimodal distributions, b <= 5/9. For balanced two-component symmetric Gaussian mixtures, b > 5/9 iff Delta/sigma_0 > 1.854.

Exact_Claim: Theorem 1: Computational complexity of GAC pipeline is T_GAC = O(ND + ...), scaling linearly O(N) for fixed ensemble parameters, with O(NL + L^2) auxiliary memory.
Statistical_Method: Asymptotic operational summation and empirical power-law regression.
Limitations: Empirical power-law exponent (beta < 1.0) reflects pre-asymptotic constant overheads; true lower bound is Omega(N).
Safe_Manuscript_Wording: Theorem 1 (Complexity): Overall time complexity scales linearly as O(N) for fixed ensemble parameters, with auxiliary working graph memory bounded by O(NL + L^2).

Limitations: Collapses on non-convex manifolds (ARI = -0.003 on Concentric Circles). Valid only for convex/hyper-ellipsoidal clusters.
Safe_Manuscript_Wording: Active subspace centroid projection maps new observations in O(K |F_active|) time without graph recomputation, strictly under the assumption of convex, hyper-ellipsoidal cluster geometry (failing on non-convex manifolds).
